references.text: Moses tells about the manna that was gathered and eaten by the children of Israel in the wilderness, which prefigures Jesus' miraculous provision of food.
The psalm describes how God satisfied His people in the wilderness, parallel to how Jesus satisfied the crowd.
Describes a similar miracle where Jesus feeds five thousand men, plus women and children, with five loaves and two fish.
Luke's account of how everyone ate and was satisfied during a similar miracle performed by Jesus.
John tells about a similar miracle where Jesus feeds five thousand men with five barley loaves and two small fish.
